problem.passage:
Marine biologists studying deep-sea hydrothermal vent communities have long been puzzled by the ______ of tube worms that thrive near vents but perish within days if relocated even a few meters away. These animals lack digestive systems entirely, relying on internal bacteria to convert chemicals into nutrients, a partnership so precise that any shift in temperature or mineral concentration disrupts the delicate chemical balance the bacteria require. Researchers now believe this narrow tolerance explains why the worms cannot simply migrate toward richer vent sites when their current location becomes depleted, even though such movement would seem to be a straightforward way to escape a dying vent.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: Marine biologists studying deep-sea hydrothermal vent communities have long been puzzled by the ______ of tube worms that thrive near vents but perish within days if relocated even a few meters away. These animals lack digestive systems entirely, relying on internal bacteria to convert chemicals into nutrients, a partnership so precise that any shift in temperature or mineral concentration disrupts the delicate chemical balance the bacteria require. Researchers now believe this narrow tolerance explains why the worms cannot simply migrate toward richer vent sites when their current location becomes depleted, even though such movement would seem to be a straightforward way to escape a dying vent.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.explanation: The passage describes tube worms that die within days of even a small relocation, because their internal bacterial partnership depends on an extremely narrow, precise range of temperature and mineral conditions. This vulnerability to any environmental shift is best captured by "fragility." "Specialization" reflects the precise bacterial partnership but misses the emphasis on how easily that balance is disrupted and the animals die. "Endurance" wrongly suggests the worms can withstand change, contradicting the text's point that they perish quickly. "Curiosity" has nothing to do with a biological dependency on stable conditions.
problem.evidenceSpan: a partnership so precise that any shift in temperature or mineral concentration disrupts the delicate chemical balance the bacteria require
problem.answerRationale: Because the bacterial partnership collapses with any small environmental shift, the worms die within days of relocation, so the blank must denote extreme vulnerability to change, i.e., fragility.

difficultyReasons: 빈칸 뒤 문장이 취약성을 직접적으로 설명해주므로 1단계 추론만 필요
정답 fragility와 오답들 간 공유 정보가 크지 않아 변별이 쉬움
endurance는 명백히 반대 의미라 obvious로 처리 가능

distractors.plausibleBecause: 관 벌레와 박테리아 간의 정밀한 공생 관계가 '전문화'로 보일 수 있어 그럴듯하다
distractors.matches: 내부 박테리아에 의존하는 소화계 없는 공생 관계라는 정보와 일부 일치
distractors.whyWrong: specialization은 공생 관계의 정밀함을 설명하지만, 빈칸이 요구하는 것은 '몇 미터만 옮겨도 며칠 안에 죽는' 현상 자체를 가리키는 단어로, 이는 연약함(fragility)을 의미하지 성공적인 전문화 자체를 뜻하지 않는다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 극한 환경(열수구)에서 생존한다는 점에서 '인내력'처럼 보일 수 있다
distractors.matches: 열수구 근처에서 번성한다는 정보와 피상적으로 일치
distractors.whyWrong: endurance(인내력)는 오히려 정반대의 의미로, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 이들이 조금만 환경이 바뀌어도 죽는다는 것을 설명하므로 인내력이 아니라 취약성을 나타내야 한다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 연구자들이 오랫동안 궁금해했다는 서술과 연결지어 '호기심'을 떠올릴 수 있다
distractors.matches: long puzzled라는 연구자의 태도와 표면적으로 연결
distractors.whyWrong: curiosity는 연구자의 감정이지 관 벌레 자체의 특성을 설명하는 단어가 아니며, 빈칸은 관 벌레의 속성을 묘사해야 한다
